description: Offline: given a Renovate `schedule` (later-text like `before 4am on Monday` or cron with `*` minutes; a string or array, the same shape as the `schedule` / `automergeSchedule` options and a packageRules entry's `schedule`) and an optional `timezone`, report whether it is active at `from` (default: now) and the next `count` run windows (default 5) as ISO timestamps in both UTC and the timezone. Evaluated with Renovate's own parser and matcher in a worker thread by probing every hour over a 366-day horizon, so the windows match what Renovate's isScheduledNow decides. An invalid schedule or timezone returns `valid: false` with Renovate's own message plus the reminder that Renovate then runs at any time. Without `timezone` the schedule is evaluated in UTC — what Renovate does when the config has no `timezone` and its runner's clock is UTC. Renovate only starts work on a run that falls inside a window, so the real PR time also depends on how often it runs.

count.description: How many upcoming windows to return (1–50, default 5).

from.description: ISO 8601 instant to evaluate from, e.g. 2026-10-29T12:00:00Z. Defaults to now.

schedule.description: The schedule to explain — a string or an array of strings, exactly as written in the config.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Berlin — the config's `timezone`. Defaults to UTC (reported as timezoneAssumed: true).

name: explain_schedule
title: Explain when a Renovate schedule runs
